changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 3 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_SK).
